headline: Asensio out 3 months as leaders Galatasaray host Fenerbahçe
summary: Galatasaray lead the Süper Lig on 19 points and host Fenerbahçe at RAMS Park on Monday in the Intercontinental Derby. BeIN Sports report Fenerbahçe's Marco Asensio is out for 3 months after knee surgery. Galatasaray won 4-2 at Lille in the Champions League in midweek; Fenerbahçe lost 0-6 at Aston Villa in Europe a week earlier, yet still create chances worth 2.57 goals a game. The market makes the hosts 42.5% favourites, with Fenerbahçe at 32.1%, and the handicap line at a quarter of a goal. The goal line is 3.25, so an open derby is expected.
read: Galatasaray, top of the Süper Lig, host Fenerbahçe in the Intercontinental Derby at RAMS Park, and the market makes them 42.5% favourites against 32.1%. Both arrive from Champions League nights — Galatasaray won 4-2 at Lille, Fenerbahçe lost 0-6 at Aston Villa and then let a two-goal lead slip against Slavia Prague, a game in which Nathan Ake came off injured — and the market's 50/50 goal total of 3.15 points to an open derby.

facts.fact: Galatasaray are 42.5% to win the derby at home, Fenerbahçe 32.1%.
facts.meaning: The market makes the league leaders clear favourites, but a derby at RAMS Park is not priced as one-sided.

facts.fact: Galatasaray lead the Süper Lig on 19 points from eight games; Fenerbahçe are third.
Galatasaray won 4-2 away at Lille in the Champions League, coming from behind twice for their first points of the campaign.
facts.meaning: They go into the derby on a winning note in Europe rather than on the back of their heavy home defeat by Barcelona.

facts.fact: Nathan Ake could not continue after picking up an injury in Fenerbahçe's Champions League match against Slavia Prague, reported a day before this derby build-up.
facts.meaning: Fenerbahçe may be without a senior defender at RAMS Park, days after he came off injured.

facts.fact: Marco Asensio will be out for three months after knee surgery, having played through the injury.
facts.meaning: Fenerbahçe lose an attacking midfielder for the derby and well beyond it.

facts.fact: Fenerbahçe lost 0-6 away at Aston Villa in the Champions League.
facts.meaning: Their away form in Europe is the biggest question mark going into a derby on the road.

facts.fact: Fenerbahçe averaged 2.57 expected goals per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They are creating chances at a high rate, so the away side is unlikely to sit deep and defend at RAMS Park.

facts.fact: Galatasaray have conceded 11 goals across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: The league leaders score but also leak; home advantage has not meant clean sheets for them.

sources.fact: Galatasaray won 4-2 away at Lille in the Champions League, coming from behind twice to claim their first points of the campaign.
After the Lille win, Galatasaray coach Okan Buruk turned his focus to the Fenerbahce derby.
Victor Osimhen scored against his former club Lille, his first Champions League goal this season.
The match is the Intercontinental Derby, one of football's biggest rivalries, with Galatasaray based on the European side of the Bosphorus and Fenerbahce on the Asian side.
Fenerbahce were denied a much-needed Champions League win when Slavia Prague came from two goals down to equalise late for 2-2.
Nathan Ake could not continue after suffering an injury in Fenerbahce's Champions League match against Slavia Prague ahead of the derby.
Turkish media criticised Fenerbahce after the Slavia draw, drawing comparisons with Sabah, who beat the Czech side 2-0 a week earlier.
Marco Asensio will be out for three months after knee surgery, having played through injury to help Fenerbahce.
